scopes_needed_read: ROLE with USAGE on warehouse, database, schema and SELECT on tables
auth.token_lifetime: JWT lifetime UNVERIFIED (key-pair page does not state it)
auth.refresh: Sign a new JWT per session with private key; rotate via RSA_PUBLIC_KEY_2

access_requirements.customer_admin_must_do: Option A (preferred for zero-credential): create a secure share and add our account. Option B: create a SERVICE user with our public key and a read-only role (statements below). Admin needs USERADMIN/SECURITYADMIN (CREATE USER requires USERADMIN or higher) and ACCOUNTADMIN for shares.
access_requirements.cost_to_us: Our own Snowflake account only if using shares (consumer side compute); key-pair: customer pays warehouse credits for our queries

customer_grant_statements: OPTION A SHARE (Snowflake docs): CREATE SHARE loveleeday_share;
GRANT USAGE ON DATABASE <db> TO SHARE loveleeday_share;
GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA <db>.<schema> TO SHARE loveleeday_share;
GRANT SELECT ON TABLE <db>.<schema>.<table> TO SHARE loveleeday_share;
ALTER SHARE loveleeday_share ADD ACCOUNTS=<LOVELEEDAY_ACCOUNT_LOCATOR>;   (docs pattern: ALTER SHARE sales_s ADD ACCOUNTS=xy12345, yz23456;)

OPTION B KEY PAIR: CREATE ROLE loveleeday_reader; GRANT USAGE ON WAREHOUSE <wh> TO ROLE loveleeday_reader; GRANT USAGE ON DATABASE <db> TO ROLE loveleeday_reader; GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA <db>.<schema> TO ROLE loveleeday_reader; GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA <db>.<schema> TO ROLE loveleeday_reader; GRANT SELECT ON FUTURE TABLES IN SCHEMA <db>.<schema> TO ROLE loveleeday_reader;   (role/grant syntax assembled from standard Snowflake grammar; not fetched verbatim)

CREATE USER loveleeday_svc TYPE=SERVICE DEFAULT_ROLE=loveleeday_reader RSA_PUBLIC_KEY='<PUBLIC_KEY_NO_DELIMITERS>' NETWORK_POLICY=<policy>;   (docs: TYPE=SERVICE, RSA_PUBLIC_KEY, NETWORK_POLICY params)
GRANT ROLE loveleeday_reader TO USER loveleeday_svc;
Existing user variant (docs): ALTER USER example_user SET RSA_PUBLIC_KEY='MIIBIjANBgkqh...';  'Exclude the public key delimiters in the SQL statement.'
rate_limits: No fixed API limit; bounded by warehouse concurrency (UNVERIFIED)
incremental_sync: Streams (CDC) or a high-water-mark column; shares are live so query with updated_at filter (Streams detail UNVERIFIED, not fetched)
blockers: Secure share requires cross-region/cloud replication if our account sits elsewhere (UNVERIFIED)
Key-pair needs customer network policy to allow our egress IPs
